# ASHRAE

> > ASHRAE is the American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers, a professional organization advancing HVAC&R innovation, standards, and industry leadership since 1894.

ASHRAE serves as the global authority for HVAC&R professionals, offering membership, volunteer opportunities, technical standards, and advocacy for building decarbonization and energy efficiency. The organization connects industry leaders through conferences, publications, and collaborative initiatives to shape the future of heating, cooling, and refrigeration technology.

## Key Topics

- HVAC&R
- Building Decarbonization

## About ASHRAE

- [About ASHRAE](https://ashrae.org/about): Overview of ASHRAE organization history and mission since 1894
- [Mission and Vision](https://ashrae.org/about/mission-and-vision): ASHRAE's mission, vision, and organizational values for HVAC&R industry
- [ASHRAE And Industry History](https://ashrae.org/about/mission-and-vision/ashrae-industry-history): Historical timeline of ASHRAE founding, mergers, and HVAC&R industry development
- [Society Snapshot](https://ashrae.org/about/society-snapshot): Annual report summarizing ASHRAE initiatives, conferences, publications, and achievements
- [2025-2028 Strategic Planning Documents](https://ashrae.org/about/strategic-plan): ASHRAE's 2025-2028 strategic planning documents and long-term organizational strategy

## Leadership & Governance

- [Leadership](https://ashrae.org/about/leadership): ASHRAE leadership structure including Board of Directors and Executive Council
- [ASHRAE Board of Directors](https://ashrae.org/about/leadership/ashrae-board-of-directors): ASHRAE Board members including Executive Committee and Regional Directors
- [ASHRAE President](https://ashrae.org/about/leadership/ashrae-president): Bill McQuade, 2025-26 ASHRAE President, focusing on healthy building design
- [Leadership Voices](https://ashrae.org/about/leadership/leadership-voices): Nearly 100 interviews with HVAC&R industry leaders on their contributions
- [Presidential Members Gallery](https://ashrae.org/about/leadership/presidential-members-gallery): Gallery of ASHRAE presidential members with speeches and leadership interviews
- [Governance](https://ashrae.org/about/governance): ASHRAE governance structure including Code of Ethics and organizational bylaws
- [MOU and Agreements](https://ashrae.org/about/governance/memoranda-of-understanding): Memoranda of Understanding with AIHA, AIA, ASHE, AMCA, and other organizations
